subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps (economic buyer & budget)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia@alphatech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood demo recap + next steps

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Demo highlights: low-latency LLM inference, predictable reserved capacity, and the cost controls we discussed (batching + quantization profiles).
- Your stated priorities: production latency under 200ms p95, clear cost guardrails, and SOC2/compliance visibility for the audit team.

Can you confirm who the economic buyer and the budget owner will be on your side? That will help me pull together a tailored pricing/commitment recommendation and a short SOW for procurement.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro call with economic buyer + budget owner (30 min) — we’ll cover expected throughput, cost estimate, and procurement timeline.
2) Share SOW and standard commercial terms for review.

I’ve attached the deck we walked through and a draft SOW template.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(alex.martinez@redwood.ai)

Attachments: Redwood-Demo-Deck.pdf, SOW-template.pdf
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia@alphatech.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood demo recap + next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear recap and for the deck — good session. Short answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Daniel Park (CTO) — dpark@alphatech.io. He owns platform spend and will sign off on technical and strategic fit.
- Budget owner / procurement: Monica Ruiz (CFO) — monica@alphatech.io. She owns the annual cloud/infra budget and will handle procurement and PO.

Both are roughly aligned on timing; we’re looking at Q1-2027 procurement but need a cost estimate and a clear SOW to present internally. Can you send a pricing scenario for a 6-12 month pilot (reserved capacity + burst)? Also please include any compliance artifacts (SOC2 summary).

I can introduce you to Daniel and Monica if you want — copying them on the next note works for me.

Cheers,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering | AlphaTech
sofia@alphatech.io
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:35:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Redwood demo recap + next steps (internal)

Marissa / Vivek —

Sofia confirmed the economic buyer (Daniel, CTO) and the budget owner (Monica, CFO). She’s happy for an intro.

Request: can you review the attached SOW-template and the pricing scenarios I drafted in the HubSpot deal note? I’m leaning toward proposing a 6-month reserved pilot (X GPUs equivalent) with a burst pool and committed throughput target — that should fit their Q1 procurement window while keeping cost up/downside predictable.

I’ve added two pricing scenarios in HubSpot (conservative + aggressive) and linked the draft SOW here: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Key asks for the intro call:
- Quick overview of throughput targets (we need their expected concurrent sessions / avg tokens/min)
- Outline compliance checklist (SOC2 evidence + data residency notes)
- Procurement timeline (target sign date and PO owner)

Happy to draft the intro email to Daniel/Monica — want to include technical / commercial owners on the thread.

Thanks,
Alex

Attachments: SOW-template.pdf
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <dpark@alphatech.io>, Monica Ruiz <monica@alphatech.io>

Subject: Intro: Redwood + AlphaTech (pricing + SOW for pilot)

Hi Daniel / Monica —

Per Sofia’s note, happy to e-introduce. I’m Alex, AE at Redwood Inference — we help platform teams run high-throughput LLM inference with predictable latency and cost.

Short context: we’re proposing a 6-month reserved pilot (dedicated capacity + burst) so AlphaTech can validate latency and cost at production scale. Attached are:
- A short pricing scenarios doc (conservative + aggressive)
- Draft SOW for procurement review
- SOC2 summary + compliance checklist

Next steps: could we schedule a 30-min call this week to align on throughput assumptions and procurement timeline? Monica, if helpful I can include a one-page commercial summary tailored to the CFO view (TCO, committed vs. on-demand costs, termination terms).

Sofia, thanks for the intro — cc’ing Marissa (solutions) and Vivek (runtime engineering) to help with technical and compliance questions.

Best regards,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(alex.martinez@redwood.ai)
